facts.claim: Skytree has two observation levels; its base is part of Skytree Town and Solamachi. Oshiage and Tokyo Skytree Station provide access.
The official tourism guide recommends advance tickets for a smoother visit and notes availability can vary.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: purchase advance tickets online to ensure a smooth visit
